paite: Huai ni chiang in TOUPA'N, anamsau hoihtak a hiam, lianpi, muanhuaitak in, leviathan gulpi hattak leh leviathan gulpi kivial ngeingoi agawt ding a, tuipi a dragon om leng athat ding hi.
heading: Israel Tunding Nawnna
english: In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan, the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.

paite: Huai ni chiang in, uain grephuan khat, huai pahtawi in la sa un.
english: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!

paite: Kei TOUPA lah avengpa ka hi a; mitphiat kal teng in tui ka buak ding a, kuamah in akhoihlouhna ding un sun leh zan in ka veng ding.
english: I, Yahweh, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.

paite: Kei ah hehna a-om kei hi; loulingnei leh khaulingneite'n hon dou in hon sual le u aw! Amau sual ding in ka kuan ding a, mun khat ah ka halkhawm ding hi.
english: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.

paite: Ahihkeileh, hon kileppihna ding in ka hatna len hen; ahi, hon kileppih hen.
english: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”

paite: Hun hong tung ding ah Jakobte'n zung akha ding ua; Israelte'n zung akha ding ua; Israelte apakmum un apakpalh ding uh; huchi in leitung gah in adimsak ding uhi.
english: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.

paite: Amah vote avuak bang in amah avo sam a hia? Ahihkeileh, amah thatte thahna bang in amah thah in a-om a hia?
english: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?

paite: Amah na paimangsak lai in ahun lel in amah na sel a; suahlam huih nun ni in ahu thupitak in amah amutlengta hi.
english: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.

paite: Huaiziak in hiai in Jakobte thulimlouhna silsiang ahi ding a, hiai akhelhna uh paimangpihna gah ngen ahi; Asherim hiam, gimlim maitamte hiam ding nawn lou ding khop in maitam suang tengteng suangpak den khap bang in abawl uhi.
english: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherah poles and the incense altars shall rise no more.

paite: Khua kulhpi nei lah alungzuang a, omna nutsiat leh paisan, gamdai bang ahi; huai ah bawngnou ata ding a, huai lai mah ah akual ding a, aselte ane ding.
english: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.

paite: Ahiangte lah avuai chiang un khiah in a-om ding a; numeite ahong pai ding ua ahal ding uh; amau lah theihtheihna himhim neiloumi ahi ngal ua; huaiziak in amaute bawlpa'n atung uah zahngaihna anei kei ding a, amaute sutuahpa'n amaute deihsakna himhim anei kei ding hi.
english: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.

paite: Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N, Euphrates Luipi akuang dim a luang zoizoi a kipan in, Aigupta luita pha in, agah asatkhe ding a, huchi in Israel suante aw, khatkhat a pikhawm in na om ding uhi.
english: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.

paite: Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, pengkul lianpi amut ding ua; Assuria gam a mangthang dekdekte leh Aigupta gam a delhkhiak a omte ahong pai ding ua; Jerusalem a tang siangthou ah TOUPA abe ding uhi.
english: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship Yahweh in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.
